speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss. To better understand what's going on, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you've noticed any fevers or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That significant weight loss is concerning; have you noticed any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or night sweats during these months? Also, have you experienced any changes in your bowel habits or noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, and ESR.
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

speaker: Patient
text: No fever, night sweats, or significant changes in bowel habits. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.
